reader.notes: The beyond-minimum row reads FileModel.VaryMin (integer-2, else the smallest record at its minimum ODO extent) and the key's window in its own record. Which files count as variable is the implementor's under §1985:II.2.1.4.3 and VII.3.8.4 GR13, and the compiler applies DOC-A.1-147 consistently.

refuter.evidence: r5from6 (VARYING FROM 6 TO 20, smallest record 10, key bytes 7..10) -> COBOL0863 minimum size 6 (correct); r5odomin / r5dep (VARYING with no FROM, ODO record minimum 10, key 9..12; and VARYING DEPENDING ON W) -> COBOL0863 minimum 10 (correct); r5odominok key 7..10 admitted. But r5cont6 (RECORD CONTAINS 6 TO 20, the same records, key bytes 7..10) is ADMITTED at --std 85 (exit 0, N=06 REC=AAAA111122223333XXYY) and REFUSED at --std 2023 (COBOL0863 'minimum size 6'). Cause: FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs#BindRecordClause sets VaryingRecordInfo.BoundsEnforced only for VARYING or DialectBehaviors.IsActive(RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize) (from 2002, kb/Work PB5197, a WRITE-bounds fix), and FileModel.cs#VaryMin then ignores integer-4 at 85 and takes the smallest record, so the PB5197 edition switch also moves this key-window rule; the reader's 'behaviour-differs-by-edition: no' and edition-consulted list miss it, and the reader's Format 3 probe (c5contains_bad, integer-4 = smallest record = 10) cannot tell the two readings apart. The verdict rests on a reading: SR5's x is 'the minimum record size specified for the file', and for Format 3 §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14 says integer-4 refers to the minimum number of characters in the smallest record (so x = integer-4 = 6 and r5cont6 must be refused), while the same GR14 says the size of each record is completely defined in the record description entry (so x = 10, and an integer-4 below the smallest record is a program GR14 does not describe). cite.py: OK  §1985:IX.2.5.3 SR5  (║2.5.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR5; OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR14; OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR13  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR13; OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR6  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6.

refuter.corrected: Not decided by the text. If SR5's 'specified' minimum is integer-4 for a variable Format 3 file, the 85 arm under-rejects (r5cont6 must be refused, as at 2023) and the cause is (a): PB5197's WRITE-bounds switch leaks into the key-window rule through VaryMin. If GR14's last sentence governs, the verdict stands, but the edition dependence should be recorded.
